metadata.title: Home AI — family apps from a prompt
metadata.description: Connect your external services and build small web/script apps from a prompt.

auth.name: Name
auth.signupDisabledDescription: This instance is invite-only. Ask an admin for an invitation link.
auth.inviteSubtitle: You have been invited to join Home AI
auth.invalidInvite: This invitation is invalid or expired

users.intro: Family access management: admins configure the platform (API keys, tests), members use the apps and their own connections.
users.cannotChangeOwnRole: You cannot change your own role
users.invitesDescription: Invite-only: create a link for a new member (48h, single-use). Share the link by copy-paste.
users.inviteLinkBody: The link is valid for 48 hours and can be used only once.
users.removeConfirmDescription: Their apps, scripts, connections and data will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.listDescription: Arrange your apps on a 12-column grid, displayed side by side as iframes.
dashboards.emptyDescription: Create a dashboard, then add your apps by arranging them on a 12-column grid.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Your small web apps created from a prompt, ready to open and share.
apps.promptPlaceholder: e.g. Show the weather and my next 5 calendar events…
apps.createHint: The app is created instantly. With a prompt, the AI runs the analysis then the code generation, shown step by step in the editor chat. Without a prompt you land on an empty editor.
apps.emptyDescription: Create your first app from a prompt: describe what you want, the AI generates the code and serves it under /a/slug.
apps.noResultsDescription: No app matches your search or filters. Try widening the criteria.
apps.resultCount: {count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} of {total}

templates.sectionDescription: Start faster from a prebuilt template — one-click install.
templates.fromTemplateHint: Already-installed templates stay available here to create a new app.

home.description: An overview of your apps, scheduled tasks and connections.
home.emptyDescription: Start by connecting a service (Google, mailbox), then create your first app from a prompt.
home.allClear: All good: no failing script, no connection to fix.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Your connected external services, usable by your apps and scripts through the SDK.
connections.providerGoogleDescription: Drive, Calendar, Gmail and Sheets. One-click OAuth connection.
connections.providerSmtpDescription: Send emails from your apps and scripts.
connections.providerTelegramDescription: Send Telegram messages from apps/scripts (bot). Great for family notifications.
connections.providerHomeAssistantDescription: Home automation: Home Assistant states & services.
connections.providerWebhookDescription: Generic webhook: trigger n8n, IFTTT, Zapier or any HTTP.
connections.addDescription: Pick a service to connect: your apps and scripts will be able to use it through the SDK.
connections.noResultsDescription: No connection matches your search or filters.
connections.resultCount: {count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} of {total}
connections.empty: No connections yet. Start by connecting Google, or add a mailbox above.
connections.deleteDescription: Apps and scripts that use it will stop working until a new connection is added.

dashboardEditor.appAlreadyAdded: This app is already on the dashboard.
dashboardEditor.widgetCount: {count, plural, one {# app} other {# apps}} · 12 columns
dashboardEditor.dragHint: Drag from the grey bar, resize from the bottom-right corner.
dashboardEditor.pickerLabel: Add an app to the dashboard
dashboardEditor.pickerEmpty: No app with a UI. Create an app first.

appEditor.deleteKeyDescription: The stored value will be permanently lost.
appEditor.clearStorageTitle: Clear all storage for this app?
appEditor.clearStorageDescription: All keys and their values will be permanently lost.
appEditor.chatHint: Describe what you want: “Show my next 5 Google Calendar events with the weather.”
appEditor.planEditHint: Review it, edit if needed, then generate the code.
appEditor.previewEmpty: Generate a first version to see the result.
appEditor.versionsDescription: History of the app's generations, newest first. Restore a version to roll back.
appEditor.tagsHint: Confirm with Enter or a comma. Tags are used to filter the catalogue.
appEditor.dangerDescription: Permanently delete this app and all its data.
appEditor.deleteConfirmQuestion: Confirm permanent deletion of this app?

storageExplorer.title: Storage
storageExplorer.description: Persisted data for this app (JSON KV) and global storage shared across apps.
storageExplorer.empty: No data stored. Create a key to get started.
storageExplorer.deleteDescription: The stored value will be permanently lost.
storageExplorer.clearDescription: All keys and their values will be permanently lost.
storageExplorer.manifestDescription: What this app exposes to the assistant and MCP (auto-generated from the HTML, editable).
storageExplorer.manifestEmpty: No declared tool — add a #home-manifest script in the HTML or edit the JSON.
storageExplorer.missingHint: Keys declared in the code but missing from storage: {keys}.
storageExplorer.builderHint: Define the table columns (name + type). Rows can be added afterwards.
storageExplorer.unsavedDescription: You have unsaved changes on “{key}”. Close without saving?

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Persisted data for the apps (JSON KV) and global storage shared across apps.
storage.noApps: No apps yet — global storage is still available.

state.title: User state
state.description: Derived, read-only view of what the platform knows about you: connections, apps, scripts, storage, durable memory and signals (routines, health, interests). Everything is recomputed on demand — nothing is written.

scripts.title: Scripts
scripts.description: Server scripts: scheduled, on-demand or webhook-triggered, with a run history.
scripts.scheduleInvalid: Invalid cron expression (5 fields: min hour day month weekday).
scripts.toggleError: Could not change the script state.
scripts.deleteDescription: Its code, versions and run history will be lost.
scripts.createPlaceholder: e.g. Every Monday at 8am, email me a summary of my unread mail…
scripts.webhookHint: Public URL to call (n8n, IFTTT, sensor…). The JSON body is exposed to the code via home.webhook.payload.
scripts.webhookPayloadHint: Authentication: x-webhook-secret header with this secret.
scripts.createHint: Creation goes through the global assistant (strict context). Pick the trigger, describe what you need: the assistant proposes an editable plan before generating the code.
scripts.createWithAssistant: Create a script with the assistant
scripts.createShortcut: Shortcut: ⌘J then describe your script (editable plan in the chat).
scripts.refinePlaceholder: Improve the script with a prompt (e.g. add an email reminder)…
scripts.noFlow: No steps recorded for this run.
scripts.emptyDescription: A script is a piece of code the server runs: at a fixed time (a mail summary on Monday morning), on demand (a button), or triggered by an incoming webhook (n8n, IFTTT…).
scripts.planEditHint: Review it, edit if needed, then run the code generation.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.description: Drive your platform in plain language: apps, scripts, dashboards and connected services.
assistant.placeholder: e.g. Create an app that shows the weather, then a script that emails me every Monday…
assistant.emptyDescription: I can create and edit your apps and scripts, organise your dashboards, and call your connected services (Google, mail, Telegram…).
assistant.destructiveNotice: Some actions (deletion, execution) will ask for your confirmation.
assistant.startHint: Try for example: “Create an app that shows my next 5 Google Calendar events with the weather”.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: LLM providers, default models and member management.
settings.languageDescription: Interface language. Defaults to your browser's language.
settings.providersDescription: API key status: the key stored in the database overrides the env variable (or fills in for it). The test sends a “ping” to the provider's default model.
settings.apiKeyPlaceholder: API key (leave empty to use the env variable)
settings.keysManagedByAdmin: API keys are managed by an administrator.
settings.openRouterHintBody: If a model returns 404 “guardrail / data policy”, check Privacy: enable “Allow free endpoints that train…” and “…publish prompts”, disable “Zero Data Retention only”, and clear Allowed/Ignored providers. A 403 “age 18+” needs confirmation at Preferences.
settings.openRouterMuseSparkHint: Muse Spark: the “contributor” tier is free via the opencode-go provider. On OpenRouter, “meta/muse-spark-1.2” (standard) needs an age confirmation at Preferences, and a 404 on “contributor” often comes from a privacy/guardrail filter on its single Meta provider.
settings.apiKeyRequired: Enter an API key before saving.
settings.keyCleared: Key {provider} removed — the env variable takes over.
settings.modelsDescription: Used when the app or script does not specify a model. Leave empty to fall back to the server defaults.
settings.modelsNone: No model list retrieved for this provider — free text.
settings.tokensDescription: API keys for an external agent (e.g. hermes on a VPS) to interact with home-ai via the REST API or MCP. They replace the session: the token is shown only once, then revocable.
settings.tokenCreatedBody: The plaintext token is shown only once. It cannot be recovered afterwards.
settings.tokensEmpty: No tokens. Create one to allow agent access.
settings.memoryDescription: What the assistant remembers about you across conversations. Editable, injected into every reply to personalize it. Auto-extraction runs in the background after each turn.
settings.memoryEmpty: No memories yet. Ask the assistant to remember something or keep chatting.
settings.briefDescription: Each morning, the assistant aggregates apps, scripts, storages, memories and (if connected) calendar/weather to write a summary in the pinned "Journal" thread.
settings.briefHourHint: Server local time. The brief is sent once per day after this hour.
settings.mcpDescription: Streamable HTTP entry point for external agents (hermes, Claude Desktop…). Auth via personal access token (Bearer hai_…) or session.
settings.mcpUrlHint: POST only (Streamable HTTP, stateless). Shows your local origin; in prod use https://your-domain/api/mcp.
settings.mcpTokenHint: Create a token in Access then use Authorization: Bearer hai_… . The token lastUsedAt is updated on each call.
settings.mcpToolsDescription: Catalog exposed via MCP (shared registry + app manifest tools).
settings.mcpCallsDescription: Last 50 MCP tool calls (this account only).
settings.mcpCallsEmpty: No MCP call recorded yet. Trigger a tool via an MCP client.
settings.mcpCallsHint: Best-effort, truncated to 4 KB per field. Retention: 30 days / 500 max (coming).
settings.usageQuotaDescription: Token limits per period. Leave empty for unlimited. New generations and AI calls are blocked until the next period when a quota is reached.
settings.quotaHint: 0 or empty = unlimited. Resets each day / week (Monday) / month.
settings.quotaInvalid: Invalid quota: enter a positive integer.
settings.usageFamilyDescription: Aggregated consumption per member this month.

errors.forbidden: This action is restricted to administrators
errors.signupDisabled: Sign-ups are closed — ask an admin for an invitation link
errors.invalidInvite: This invitation is invalid or expired
errors.storageConflict: This key was modified elsewhere while you were editing — reload it before retrying
errors.storageNotATable: The value of this key is not an array (table operation impossible)
errors.rowNotFound: Row not found in this table (it may have been deleted)
errors.scriptFieldsRequired: appId, name, schedule and code are required
errors.mailFieldsRequired: host, user and pass are required
